section_summary: This section comprises entry permit applications, military clearances, memoranda of conversation, and diplomatic notes concerning travel to occupied Japan under SCAP Circular No. 8 between September 1947 and March 1948. It details commercial quotas and clearances for businessmen and government officials from Siam, Iran, Mexico, Canada, China, and the Philippines, alongside missionary entry requests for Catholic clergy and sisters. The correspondence addresses clearance notifications, documentation under Circular No. 8, baggage allowances, re-entry permit arrangements, and permanent residency requests by stateless individuals.
